data.title: PDS Biotechnology Amends Promissory Note, Tightens Financing Terms
data.description:
PDS Biotechnology ( (PDSB) ) has provided an update.

On August 31, 2026, PDS Biotechnology entered into a First Amendment to a $6 million promissory note with YA II PN, Ltd., tightening how proceeds from its at-the-market equity program are remitted to the lender, including weekly reporting of net proceeds and near-immediate payments of applicable amounts. The amendment also extended the cure period for any Nasdaq listing deficiency from 75 to 180 days and required that all net cash from other equity or equity-linked financings be used for mandatory redemption to the lender within five business days, a move that increases lender protection and constrains the company’s flexibility in using new financing proceeds.

data.title: Greenland Mines expands capital structure after Sarfartoq acquisition
data.description:
Greenland Mines ( (GRML) ) has shared an update.

On September 1, 2026, Greenland Mines completed an Acquisition that transferred to the company the mineral license for the Sarfartoq rare earth project in Greenland via a merger of NNSR Holdings Inc. into its Merger Sub, without changing control or its leadership. The closing followed an independent Initial Assessment showing the ST1 deposit alone could deliver a pre-tax NPV of about $2.05 billion and a pre-tax IRR of 118.6%, with five additional rare earth occurrences on the license still largely untested.

As consideration for the deal, Greenland Mines issued 1,040,676 new common shares and 359,324 Series R preferred shares to former NNSR stockholders in a private, exempt offering. Two days later, on September 3, 2026, shareholders approved share issuances linked to the earlier Greenland Mines Corp. acquisition and a February 2026 private placement, as well as an expansion of the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan to 400,000 common shares, collectively bolstering the company’s capital structure and flexibility to fund project development and incentivize management.
